cutoff_validity.reason: data/reference/team_cities.csv carries no row-level source timestamp. Its only temporal evidence is a single git commit dated at or after every game date in the universe.
cutoff_validity.explicit_non_inference: The content is time-invariant physical fact, but time-invariance of content is NOT a proof of cutoff validity of the record, and this node does not treat it as one.
cutoff_validity.consequence: Nothing here may be cited as cutoff-valid. Any downstream admission must establish cutoff validity separately.

eligibility.statement: This node establishes joinability and merge safety only. Availability is not eligibility and eligibility is not admission. No column is admitted to any feature matrix by this output.
eligibility.structural_fact_bearing_on_future_eligib: elevation_ft in its STATIC per-team form is an exact bijection with team_id (15/15) and therefore carries nothing a team fixed effect does not. Its GAME-VENUE form is not a team constant (736/2982 = 24.6814% of team-games above 1000 ft). Neither observation confers eligibility; both remain CUTOFF_UNPROVEN.

contradictions.resolution: The value is a row count mislabelled as a venue count. The fourth row is the second Phoenix row - i.e. the coordinator's correction of the source counted the very duplicate S2 documents. The original source's '3' was correct about venues.

contradictions.document_says: team_cities.csv gives each team one home arena per season and the join is clean
contradictions.bytes_say: one arena per team-season is TRUE (0 teams change arena or elevation across seasons; exactly one row per team-season). 'The join is clean' is true on (team_id, season) and FALSE on team_id, where the merge yields 3228 rows against 2982.
contradictions.resolution: Neither document names the key. arena_dimension_v1.meta.json declares it machine-readably so the ambiguity cannot recur.

contradictions.document_says: team_cities.csv:first_season is franchise identity, usable for expansion / cold-start reasoning
contradictions.bytes_say: 12 of 16 rows have first_season == 2021 == the data-window start, not a founding year. Only 4 rows exceed it: GSV 2025, PDX 2026, TOR 2026 - and PHX 2025.
contradictions.resolution: first_season is LEFT-CENSORED for every pre-2021 franchise, and a rule of the form 'first_season > 2021 implies expansion franchise' misclassifies Phoenix 2025, which is an abbreviation rename. Escalated.

contradictions.document_says: cities.drop_duplicates('team_id') to build the timezone map
contradictions.bytes_say: 0 team_ids where the first and last source row disagree on timezone, so it changes no current value
contradictions.resolution: Latent, currently benign. Harmless ONLY because the two Phoenix rows happen to agree on timezone; a real relocation would be resolved silently by CSV row order. Outside this node's write scope; not touched.

confirmations.claim: 16 rows, 15 distinct team_id, team_id 1611661317 duplicated, last_season float64 with 15 of 16 null, elevation_ft range 20-2030
confirmations.measured: 16 rows, 15 distinct team_id, 1611661317 appears twice, last_season dtype float64 with 15 nulls, elevation 20-2030

could_not_establish: Per-game venue. No venue or arena column exists in any of master_team.parquet's 65 columns (verified). The dimension can only assign a team-game the home team's season-primary arena, so it silently mis-locates neutral-site games, one-off relocations, in-season arena changes and international showcases. The number of such games is unmeasurable here because the identifying data does not exist in this repository.

A known instance of that mis-location. collect_bios.py records that the Seattle Storm split early-2021 home games with Everett, WA while Climate Pledge Arena was under construction; the dimension assigns all of them to Climate Pledge Arena. The affected games cannot be enumerated - there is no per-game venue to enumerate from.

Accuracy of lat / lon / elevation_ft. Hand-entered constants with no upstream source, method, datum or stated precision. Internal consistency was verified (the distance matrix satisfies the metric axioms); external accuracy was not, and no external reference was fabricated.
Cutoff validity of any field. See cutoff_validity above: unproven by measurement, not assumed either way.
Whether any of this is scientifically usable. Out of mandate. No model fitted, no performance inspected, nothing under experiments/player_program/stage2b/SEALED_RESULTS/ read.

stop_conditions.reasoning: The dimension provably preserves the 2982-row / 1491-cluster universe, introduces no feature, changes no target, touches no K0 construction, and alters no inference structure. It removes a hazard; it does not move a boundary.
stop_conditions.s2_status: S2_team_cities_join_hazards remains marked unresolved:true in the frozen stage2a/V2_STOP_CONDITION.json, which this node did NOT edit.
